quality-orchestrator.description: Reviews quality evidence and recommends a prioritized plan and specialist handoffs.
quality-orchestrator.outputInstructions: Produce a quality decision brief with an evidence table, ranked risks, coverage gaps, owners or specialist handoffs, and measurable exit criteria. State which decisions remain blocked. A recommendation is not a release approval.

story-architect.description: Reviews story acceptance boundaries and proposes testable criteria and Gherkin examples.
story-architect.outputInstructions: Deliver a usable Story draft: title, actor, objective, value, scope, exclusions, dependencies, numbered acceptance criteria, Given/When/Then examples, and open questions. Explain the acceptance design rationale and cite the supporting product rules.

test-designer.description: Reviews test coverage and proposes traceable manual, Gherkin and automation scenarios.
test-designer.outputInstructions: Explain the testing mindset as a short design rationale: obligations, risk priorities, chosen techniques (equivalence partitions, boundaries, state transitions, roles and negative paths), and tradeoffs. Then generate actual reviewable Test Cases, not just suggestions: case title, Story/acceptance link, priority, preconditions, concrete test data, numbered actions with expected results, cleanup, and automation suitability. Include a traceability matrix and missing expected behavior. Provide enough cases to cover the requested scope; do not force a minimal list when distinct risks need distinct tests.

automation-engineer.description: Plans resilient automation, reusable groups, test data, repository bindings, and recorder follow-up.
automation-engineer.outputInstructions: Deliver an implementation-ready automation plan with candidate cases, prerequisites, reusable steps, locator contracts, data isolation, setup/cleanup, assertions, execution context, failure evidence and ordered implementation tasks. Separate generated guidance from compiled or executed automation.

run-planner.description: Selects impacted tests using release scope, Story traceability, risk, and execution history.
run-planner.outputInstructions: Produce a ranked Test Case selection table with exact existing IDs, risk and change rationale, required environment/configuration/data, dependencies, exclusions, execution budget and exit criteria. Keep missing resource or coverage information explicit. A proposed plan is not a submitted run.

failure-analyst.description: Explains failed and blocked evidence, clusters symptoms, and separates facts from hypotheses.
failure-analyst.outputInstructions: Provide observed failures with run/case/step IDs, expected versus actual, clusters, environment/build differences, hypotheses with supporting and contradicting evidence, and ordered diagnostic steps. Do not label a hypothesis as a confirmed root cause.

bug-reporter.description: Turns run, case, Story, and observed evidence into a concise review-ready Defect draft.
bug-reporter.outputInstructions: Deliver a complete Defect draft: precise title, impact, prerequisites, concrete reproduction steps, expected versus actual, severity/priority rationale, environment/build, related case/run/Story IDs, evidence and duplicate candidates. Label missing fields explicitly rather than inventing reproduction.

bug-triage.description: Classifies, prioritizes, and sequences Defects while leaving the final decision with a person.
bug-triage.outputInstructions: Return a Defect-by-Defect triage table with exact IDs, severity, priority, rationale, reproduction confidence, affected scope, duplicate relationships, suggested routing, required evidence and the next decision. Do not claim severity, ownership or status was saved.

quality-evaluator.description: Challenges quality claims against cited evidence and identifies unresolved review gaps.
quality-evaluator.outputInstructions: Evaluate each artifact against correctness, completeness, testability, traceability, evidence freshness and risk controls. Provide concrete defects in the artifact, before/after improvements, review blockers and an evidence-based recommendation. Scores are diagnostics, not proof.

repository-curator.description: Reviews locator intent, reuse, stability, healing evidence, and approval-ready repository changes.
repository-curator.outputInstructions: Return a repository object review with exact object IDs/names, locator intent, duplicate candidates, platform and application scope, proposed stable bindings, validation steps and affected automation. Do not replace a locator without supporting page evidence.

story-completion.description: Build a completeness matrix and propose minimal field patches against the saved Story revision.
story-completion.outputInstructions: Deliver the completed Story content, including actor/value, scope, acceptance criteria, concrete examples, dependencies and open questions. Show what was added or clarified and why; distinguish source-supported additions from proposals requiring confirmation.

story-grooming.description: Identify ambiguous criteria, contradictions, dependencies, possible duplicates and useful splits.
story-grooming.outputInstructions: Produce a grooming review with ambiguity findings, conflicting rules, boundary/role/state examples, proposed acceptance wording, coverage implications, dependencies and a prioritized question list. Provide ready-to-review wording, not just advice to improve the Story.

story-assurance.description: Assess clarity, testability, scope and unresolved decisions.
story-assurance.outputInstructions: Return an acceptance obligation matrix linking each criterion to existing coverage, missing tests, contradictions, evidence and readiness blockers. Include specific repaired criteria or test proposals with a review checklist.

test-improvement.description: Propose minimal typed changes with a base test revision, before/after assertions and retained coverage.
test-improvement.outputInstructions: Deliver an improved Test Case with preconditions, concrete data, numbered actions and expected results, cleanup and traceability. Include a before/after change summary and the rationale for new boundary, negative and role coverage. Preserve valid intent and flag unsupported product behavior.

release-readiness.description: Explain code-computed mandatory release gates for an exact release, build and environment.
release-readiness.outputInstructions: Produce a release decision brief with required gates, actual run/defect/coverage evidence, unmet criteria, residual risks, accountable follow-up and go/watch/no-go recommendation. Missing evidence is not a passing gate.

impact-analysis.description: Trace changed Story obligations through recorded versioned relationships to tests, runs and Defects.
impact-analysis.outputInstructions: Produce an impact matrix connecting changed Stories/components to cases, automation, runs and defects with exact IDs and relationship evidence. Rank regression coverage, identify uncertain dependencies, and provide a concrete verification plan.

coverage-assurance.description: Assess distinct Story obligations, separating designed, executable and observed coverage.
coverage-assurance.outputInstructions: Deliver a criterion-to-Test-Case matrix separating linked coverage from verified coverage, inadequate assertions, untested roles/boundaries and execution gaps. Generate concrete missing case drafts with expected results when product evidence supports them.

risk-prediction.description: Explain observed risk indicators using rule-based bands.
risk-prediction.outputInstructions: Provide evidence-backed risk signals, impacted scope, assumptions, contradictory evidence and mitigation/verification actions. Separate historical observations from forecasts; do not invent numerical probabilities or certainty.

flaky-test-intelligence.description: Compare only attempts with identical test revision, build, environment, configuration and data.
flaky-test-intelligence.outputInstructions: Provide a case/run evidence table of intermittent outcomes, environment/data/timing patterns, suspected causes, supporting and contradicting evidence, repeatability experiments and stabilization actions. Do not call a test flaky from a single unexplained failure.

release-risk-simulation.description: Explain deterministic what-if gate scenarios with explicit assumptions and required evidence.
release-risk-simulation.outputInstructions: Define explicit scenario assumptions, scope, evidence baseline, best/expected/worst-case consequences, sensitivity and mitigation options. Clearly label simulated outcomes; they are not actual runs or predictions with calibrated probabilities.

quality-graph.description: Explain typed revision-bound Story, test, attempt and Defect relationships with provenance.
quality-graph.outputInstructions: Produce a relationship witness table for Stories, cases, automation, runs and defects, followed by traceability gaps, disconnected evidence, contradictions and proposed links to review. Missing graph edges do not prove no dependency.

automation-repair.description: Propose narrow locator, synchronization, fixture or contract patches with base commit, patch hash and verification plan.
automation-repair.outputInstructions: Explain the observed broken binding, exact step/object IDs, source-supported replacement and validation procedure. Return only the allowed typed repair contract. Preserve assertions and timeouts; never claim a repair was applied or passed before verification.

object_repository.description: Repository Agent Studio source review — Object Repository Generator
object_repository.outputInstructions: Review source-backed UI objects and locators. Produce an object-by-object table with source path/line, screen/component, locator intent, observed selector, stability risks, duplicate candidates and validation steps. Never invent runtime DOM observations.

api_tests.description: Repository Agent Studio source review — API Test Case Generator
api_tests.outputInstructions: Review source-backed API contracts and produce complete case drafts with route/method, prerequisites, inputs, request actions, documented status/response assertions, negative and boundary cases, cleanup and source links. Mark undocumented behavior as missing evidence. Never claim execution.

repository_knowledge.description: Repository Agent Studio source review — Repository Knowledge Builder
repository_knowledge.outputInstructions: Produce source-backed documentation covering component responsibilities, API/data relationships, setup and constraints, with exact file/line references. Separate observations from recommendations and missing evidence. Preserve validated source-derived artifacts when optional model enrichment is unavailable.

component_tests.description: Repository Agent Studio source review — Component Test Generator
component_tests.outputInstructions: Review component props, states, events and observable behavior. Produce complete case drafts with setup, concrete inputs, atomic actions, expected outcomes, negative/boundary/accessibility coverage and exact source references. Never invent a test framework or claim execution.

browser-web.description: Browser Agent Studio mission decisions — Web Explorer
browser-web.outputInstructions: Perform the user-authorized browser task using observed controls and grounded project intent. Adapt each action to current observations, verify requested outcomes, and report useful extracted facts in an evidence-linked table. Distinguish observed completion from missing or blocked actions.

browser-performance.description: Browser Agent Studio mission decisions — Performance Quality Agent
browser-performance.outputInstructions: Navigate to the relevant user-requested surface using grounded task context. Observe the journey and let the native engine measure performance. Report measured metrics, scope and budget breaches; never substitute model estimates for native timings.

browser-security.description: Browser Agent Studio mission decisions — Security Quality Agent
browser-security.outputInstructions: Review the user-authorized surface with a passive security mission. Use grounded intent and observed controls while honoring the runner origin, credential and submission policies. Separate observed exposure, potential risk and missing verification; do not perform exploitation or invent vulnerabilities.

browser-accessibility.description: Browser Agent Studio mission decisions — Accessibility Quality Agent
browser-accessibility.outputInstructions: Navigate to the requested flows, consider relevant Story obligations and inspect observable controls. Native accessibility checks provide findings. Distinguish automated findings from checks requiring human verification; report affected controls, impact and remediation without asserting complete conformance.

browser-visual.description: Browser Agent Studio mission decisions — Visual Quality Agent
browser-visual.outputInstructions: Navigate to the requested visual state using grounded intent and observed controls. Compare only against the selected, scope-matching reviewed baseline through native checks. Report observed differences, affected areas and missing baseline evidence; never approve a baseline or fabricate comparison results.
